content:
Hot on the heels of Apple Watch Series 12 hitting its best price ever and all-time lows on AirTag 2 at $17.50, Black Friday pricing is already live on AirPods Pro 3 starting today. You can now land the best earbuds on the planet at one of the lowest prices ever.

As part of its early Black Friday sale, Amazon is pulling the trigger early on the AirPods Pro 3 discounts, delivering Apple’s best earbuds down to nearly $70 off the list price.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249)

Regularly $249, you can now head over to Amazon to score AirPods Pro 3 down to $179.99 shipped – this is among the best deals ever offered.

The $70 discount undercuts the deal we have been tracking on and off over the last few weeks by $20, delivering one of the best discounts we have tracked to date on Apple’s best. This is on par with the fall Prime Day discount and the official summer Amazon sale, landing within $10 of the limited all-time low that jumped in and out of stock back in late June this past summer.

This deal comes on the heels of AirPods Pro 3 adding a ton of new features in iOS 27. The update brought Custom EQ support to Apple’s earbuds, along with GymKit integration, better Find My support, a redesigned Settings experience, and more. They also offer a great way to interact with Siri AI, Apple’s more powerful and personal version of Siri.
